name: cone-05-bisque
description: Cone 05 bisque, from cone-05-long-bisque: 60C/h from room temperature to 93C (no full-power start on damp ware), 10 minutes at 93C, 14.5C/h to 121C, 102C/h to 316C, 133C/h to 704C, 80C/h through burnout to 899C, 120C/h to 931C, 60C/h to 1031C and a 30 minute hold. Heat-work model: cone 05 down, 04 just starting.
